  "strategy": "Last iteration: swap the ranking generator to a bagging family, which is the only untried ranking mechanism left. Bagging is the only substantively different ranking mechanism the executor offers (bootstrap-averaged deep trees, variance reduction rather than sequential bias reduction), and the documented family-swap span of 0.0022–0.0077 roc_auc means it is the one honest shot left even though it is not guaranteed to cover the 0.0082 that remains at a perfect cut. 'balanced_subsample' keeps the operating point near the recall<path> parity that iterations 3 and 4 identified as optimal, so the attempt tests the ranking rather than re-testing the cut. Deep unpruned trees are chosen because bagging controls variance by averaging, not by pruning, and train_val_gap on a forest is not the same overfitting failure that killed the depth-8 xgboost attempt (that one had no averaging over 800 independent bootstraps).
